assumptions: Spell power coefficient .1, fitted from the beta logs. The client row carries 0, as Season of Discovery's Ice Lance (400640) does: the scaling lives in a server script, and SoD's hotfix of 2024-12-04 raised it by 300% to .572. Each mage's spell power is read off their other spells in the same log (client base plus coefficient), since gear alone undercounts it. Mana (foreverlogs.gg report 2727, 2026-10-07): Fire Blast, both Frostbolt ranks, Cone of Cold, Frost Nova and Blizzard all give about 80 spell power, and rank 1 (base 27.6-32.6 at its max level 26) hit for 38.8 on average unfrozen (52 hits, 36-42) and 38.2 frozen before the x4 (32 hits), .10-.11. Toma (report 2687, 2026-09-30, level 20, about 33 spell power though gear shows 19) hit for 31.4 unfrozen, .09-.11. .143 would put every unfrozen hit of Mana's at 39 or more, but 13 land at 36-37.

The beta's combat logs (foreverlogs.gg reports 2747 and 2748, five procs off Frostbolt from four mages) gain it the moment Frostbolt's cast ends, 0.6 to 0.9 sec before the bolt lands: the next cast (Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Frostbolt) takes a charge and the bolt's own impact doesn't.
